headline: Anup Bagchi appointed Managing Director and CEO in place of Sashidhar Jagdishan
why: Top-level leadership transition for India's largest private sector bank; key strategic impact on execution.

people.name: Anup Bagchi
people.background: Over three decades of experience in financial services across banking, capital markets, wealth management, and insurance. Served in ICICI Group since 1992, including as Executive Director of ICICI Bank (2017-2023) and MD & CEO of ICICI Prudential Life Insurance.
